meta.title: Periodic colour-pattern catalog
meta.scope: perfect periodic colour-pattern representatives with one, two, or three colours
meta.warning: The finite classification is of colour-pattern types; literal motif geometries have infinitely many realizations.

definitions.pattern: P*=(P,chi): a periodic monomotif pattern P together with a colour assignment chi on motif copies.
definitions.chromatic: The colour-symmetry group acts transitively on the colours.
definitions.perfect: Every symmetry of the uncoloured pattern induces a colour permutation.
definitions.colour_pattern_type: After colour relabelling: the same colour group, coloured-motif stabilizer/induced group, and coloured-motif-transitive subgroups.

sources.authors: Branko Grünbaum and G. C. Shephard
John H. Conway, Heidi Burgiel, and Chaim Goodman-Strauss
